title: scenarios: the verified builds the ask rounds run on are committed fixtures beside their cards
body:
epic:#34659#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnXJdSZifpEN5i7aU

Filing gate: ④ a child of the cross-lane parent #34659, filed by the session the maintainer set to file this epic's cards. Ruling: the maintainer, in that session's chat, 2026-11-17, verbatim: 「两件都同意：构建提交进仓库，#34894 选 A」, on the open point (a) of the test plan on #34687 (comment 6951987764) and this session's review of it (comment 6952197238).

## Why

The daily ask round measures the MCP door, not authoring. It needs the same build every day; cloud containers are ephemeral; rebuilding each round costs about $50 a day for two cards by the plan's estimate and puts build noise into the reading.

## Evidence

- The test plan on #34687 (comment 6951987764), open point a: the round cannot start without a home for the verified builds.
- `scenario-eval` keeps run products out of the repository tree. The maintainer has now ruled that a verified build an ask round runs on is a fixture, committed.

## Scope

- One verified build per dataset card, committed beside the card, with its sha256, the runner sha and the model that built it recorded next to it.
- It changes only by a PR, when the card or the runner changes; a daily round never writes it.
- `--template` reads it from the tree; the `eval-run` record names its sha256.
- One line in `scenario-eval/SKILL.md` stating the distinction: records, recordings and logs stay out of the tree; a verified build that rounds run on is a fixture and is in it.
- File surface: `docs/qa/scenarios/**` or the runner's fixtures directory, as the devx lane places it; `.claude/skills/scenario-eval/SKILL.md`.

## Done when

- A fresh container runs the ask round on both dataset cards with no build step.

## Relations

- Parent: #34659. Related: #34687, #34869.
- Governed surface: `.claude/**` for the skill line, Tier S.
